profile_text.body:
Anthropic is a for-profit AI safety and research company founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website presents Claude as the company's primary AI, describing it as built for problem solvers and suited to tasks such as analyzing data, writing code, and working through complex challenges.

Anthropic's tracked products include Claude, a general-purpose large language model assistant available at claude.ai, and Claude Code, an agentic coding tool. The company also offers the Anthropic Console, an API management platform with tools for prompt testing, evaluation, usage monitoring, and cost controls, as well as Computer Use, an agent capability that allows Claude to control a desktop computer and perform automation at the system level, which the company notes carries high-privilege operation considerations.

The held facts record twelve active federal lawsuits naming Anthropic PBC as defendant, filed across courts in California, Delaware, Hawaii, Vermont, Massachusetts, and Pennsylvania. These include cases brought by individual plaintiffs as well as one by the University of Tennessee Research Foundation. The nature of the individual claims is not specified in the available data, but the volume and geographic spread of the litigation is notable for a company founded in 2021.
